after.followupScope: Retain internal run titles as exclusion markers even when later tool output taints the run; the pure activity pack excludes these titles from rendered owner activity.
after.productionRefinement: Shared cleanOwnerRows and ownedBriefs predicates in TrustedLearning are reused by the activity context pack; standing-work notices and workflow takeover candidates require the original directive to match proven owner transcript content.
after.assembledSourceRefinement: Final assembled source includes original-occurrence binding for owner directives plus the independent trusted-interest projection and all host interest-read wiring. This unchanged R20 fixture verifies the attachment learning/context boundary on that source.

limitations: This proves execution, provenance, persistence and context composition under a deterministic local provider; it is not a model-quality benchmark.
No full test gates were run by this lane for this focused verification.
The finding is synthetic and is not attributed to any customer incident.
